common.action.retry: Button that repeats an action that failed.
time.justNow: Relative time for something that happened under a minute ago, in the same lowercase style as '5m ago' (which the browser formats).
sync.state.inSync: The plan's freshness verdict: the plan cards were reviewed against the latest code. Shown in a small badge in the header and on the dashboard. Short.
sync.state.drifted: Freshness verdict: code changed since the plan was last synced to it. Short.
sync.state.dirty: Freshness verdict: the plan folder has edits not yet committed to git. Short.
sync.state.neverSynced: Freshness verdict: nobody has ever marked the plan as synced to the code. Short.
